headline: Istanbul Monthly Inflation Quickens in October According to ITO Data
summary: Monthly inflation in Istanbul accelerated in October compared to the previous month, according to data released by the Istanbul Chamber of Commerce (ITO).
why: Istanbul is Turkey's largest economic hub, and local chamber of commerce price indices serve as early indicators for nationwide Turkish inflation trends.

impacts.name: Turkey
impacts.why: Acceleration in regional monthly inflation readings.
